<div class="card-body">
'''That's It, The Rebels Are There!''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">間違いない、反乱軍の秘密基地だ！</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の支配フェイズに自分の宇宙船を1隻、通常どおりにフォースを消費して、自分のプローブ・ドロイドがいる位置と同じ星系に移動させる。ただし航行速度で到達できる場合に限る。その宇宙船はそのターンにはもはや移動することはできない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Thats-It-The-Rebels-Are-There-PSA-151452828.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「この星系だ。間違いなくスカイウォーカーも一緒に居る」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' That's It, The Rebels Are There!.

'''Card text:'''
During your control phase, move one of your starships, spending Force as usual, to the same system as a location where you have a Probe Droid. Only if it can be reached by hyperspeed. That starship can no longer move this turn.

'''Lore:'''
This is the system. Skywalker is certainly with them as well.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Movement is to the system matching the Probe Droid’s 位置, limited by 航行速度, not “if within range.”
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[That's It, The Rebels Are There!]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
